gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Two CharSets built from different definitions are not equal: the predefined "a-z" set differs from a set built from null definitions.
ADDED i3: A CharSet is equal to itself (reflexivity of equals).
ADDED i4: A CharSet is never equal to a plain Object of an unrelated type.
ADDED i5: The protected constructor accepts a definition array that contains null entries alongside a non-null definition string.
ADDED i6: getInstance returns a non-null CharSet for a definition array whose only non-null element is an arbitrary multi-character definition string.
ADDED i7: getInstance returns a non-null CharSet for a combined range definition "A-Xa-z".
ADDED i8: A null definition array yields the shared EMPTY CharSet, whose hashCode can be computed without error.
ADDED i9: An empty CharSet (built from a single null definition) contains no characters.
ADDED i10: The predefined lower-case alpha CharSet renders as "[a-z]".
ADDED i11: An empty CharSet (built from a single null definition) exposes an empty set of character ranges.
